name: Daily Life
overview: Scripture teaches that daily life is to be lived with wisdom and dependence on the Lord, recognizing the brevity and uncertainty of our days. We are called to trust in God wholeheartedly rather than our own understanding, committing our works to Him so that our thoughts may be established. The Lord's mercies sustain us continually, providing for our daily needs, as expressed in the prayer for daily bread. This perspective encourages a humble, God-centered approach to each day, mindful that the future is unknown and that true wisdom comes from numbering our days and applying our hearts to God's guidance.
